caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a long, straight spout on the left and an arched handle on the right. The body of the teapot is cylindrical and smooth, decorated with two horizontal bands near the top and bottom edges that feature detailed, repetitive floral and geometric patterns. In the center of the teapot’s body is a crest or shield design bearing an ornate monogram, possibly made of the letters “R” and “L”. The lid of the teapot is domed and features a stylized finial in the shape of a pineapple or similar fruit at the top. The handle appears darker in tone compared to the main body, which is rendered in lighter shades of gray. The drawing is done in grayscale, using delicate shading to convey metallic texture and form. The composition centers the teapot against a plain background, framed by a simple drawn line. The artist’s signature is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Silver Teapot
